contract.actions: Only server legalMoves and requestChoice/selectMechanic; the browser submits opaque pick/confirm/cancel moves and never computes rules.
contract.privacy: Codex entries expose id/available/used only (no branch conditions or text for untriggered entries); the time marker exposes the current day/period only; the predation bag exposes a remaining count and never its tokens; survey preparation exposes hand counts, kept assets and controlled clues but never hand card codes; grid/rail/enemy-location/form data are table-public.
contract.cancellation: Optional choices can be cancelled before any write; mandatory choices have no cancel. Empty mandatory candidate sets return false before requestChoice, so no soft lock is left.
contract.realEntry: campaign-flow.js already routes survey-preparation choices through the fhvSurvey mechanic operation; card/scenario abilities in P5–P7 call api.interactions.fhv.* instead of hand-built panels.
contract.guide: The fixed setup/reference entry and scriptCard ownership are reused; full FHV scenario guides remain P7.
contract.release: The seed/fixture is test-only and confined to tools/tests. P4 opens no content: the campaign, investigators and player cards remain catalog-only.
contract.fast: The P4 regression baseline is the failure list recorded at the end of P3; P4 only requires no new failures and every known failure to be disclosed with a reason.
